# 1. The `geo.dsta` repo (Ai-Whisperers/paraguay-geodata)

**Live:** https://geodata.paragu-ai.com/ · **Repo:** https://github.com/Ai-Whisperers/paraguay-geodata · **Local:** `/root/paraguay-geodata`

## What it is

A free, open **national-scale Paraguay geo + real-estate viewer** forked from the `la-quebrada-viva` (LQV) project. Same depth of data we built for one 10×10 km box in Escobar-Paraguarí, but extended to all ~407k km² of Paraguay.

## Scale today (live)

| Metric | Count |
|---|---|
| Property listings | **10,898** (infocasas + Clasipar + TuLugar) |
| OSM roads | 14,835 |
| OSM buildings (Asunción) | 50,000 |
| Tile fabric cells | 7,912 |
| Priority urban tiles | 37 |
| OSM departamentos | 18 |
| OSM distritos | 268 |
| OSM barrios | 1,278 |
| Catastro deptos / distritos / parcelas / urbanizaciones | 18 / 268 / 7,500 / 470 |
| GBIF species | 400 (Animalia + Plantae) |
| INBIO crop data | Soja + Arroz + Maíz across 15+ deptos |
| BCP macro snapshot | 10 indicators |
| NASA POWER climate | Daily, 3 params |
| Toggleable layers | **21** (17 on by default) |
| Deploy files | 15, ~50 MB |
| Total records published | **~35K features** across all layers |

## Architecture (one-line)

```
Sources (infocasas / OSM / Catastro / GBIF / INBIO / BCP / NASA POWER)
   → tools/ (Python fetchers + DuckDB)
   → data/ (gitignored lakes) + exports/web/data/ (small JSONs)
   → exports/web/mapa.html (single Leaflet source-of-truth viewer)
   → Cloudflare Pages (canonical) + R2 for raster-heavy >25 MiB
```

**Canonical viewer**: one `mapa.html` with `?tile=<lon>_<lat>&r=<km>` — same pattern as LQV's walkthrough, scaled nationally. **No** N HTML files for N tiles.

## Phases shipped (last 7 days)

| Wave | What landed |
|---|---|
| 0 (Jul 10) | Repo skeleton + 4-doc basis (README/STATUS/ARCHITECTURE/CLAUDE) + tile index + ethics gate |
| 1 (Jul 11) | Image hot-linking, 10.9K properties, 14.8K roads, 50K buildings, UI |
| 1.5 | Custom domain `geodata.paragu-ai.com` + `datos.paragu-ai.com` |
| 2 | PII scrub + Catastro WFS + Photon geocoder + clustering + i18n + a11y |
| 3 | Market signals, share/embed/locate, PWA manifest, URL hash sync |
| 4 | Fair-price ML (R²≈0.017, decorative) + yield calculator |
| 5 | Mobile redesign + real filters + CSV export + dead-weight cleanup (−25.7 MB) |
| 6 | Image gallery in popups + comparables + honest STATUS rewrite |
| 7-15 | Service worker + env layers (indigenous territories, climate risk, flood zones) + Guaraní translations + tests + CI + OpenAPI |
| 16-19 | Layer-state fixes + security headers (CSP/SW v4) + DuckDB queries + Wave 1 P0 infra |

Last commit: `13005c7 fix: layout — html/body 100%, main grid with max-height, aside position:relative, legend into map div`.

## What's NOT done (honest)

- **No auto-refresh** — static snapshot from last scrape, will go stale
- **No service-worker offline** — installable PWA but no cache layer yet
- **No real CI yet** — manual `wrangler deploy`
- **Fair-price ML R²≈0.017** — UI decoration, not a real valuation
- **GN (Guaraní)** — 30 keys translated, but not a full primary lang
- **No charts library** until wave 7 (Chart.js added now)

## Repo conventions (from CLAUDE.md)

- `main` is the only branch, no `develop`, commit often
- Tool naming: `tools/<verb>_<noun>.py` · Cron scripts in `scripts/<cron>.sh`
- Never push raw S2/DEM to GitHub → goes to R2 or stays local
- Never claim a deploy is live without the 4-probe pattern in STATUS.md
- 25 MiB per-file cap on CF Pages → everything >25 MB to R2

## Skills wired to this repo

- `paraguay-geodata-fork-reference` — class-level recipe (loaded above)
- `paraguay-open-data-fetch` — the 7 snap scripts for direct data fetches
- `satellite-to-blender-pipeline` — umbrella for the fork pattern
- `ethical-web-scraping-decision` — gate before scraping portals
- `lqv-bundle` — technique inherited from LQV

### El fix crítico que resolvió el problema

El bug era que **`.leaflet-tile-container` no tenía dimensiones explícitas**, así que Leaflet lo medía con `0×0` y dibujaba los tiles en posiciones absolutas del world coordinate space, sin escalarlos al viewport. Eso causaba:
- Tiles en `(756, 144)`, `(1012, 400)`, `(500, 656)`... — grilla irregular
- Solo 7 de 20 tiles en el viewport visible
- Gaps visuales entre tiles

**El fix**: agregar CSS que fuerce al `tile_container` a tener 100% × 100%:

```css
.leaflet-tile-container {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; top: 0;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
}
.leaflet-tile { position: absolute; }
.leaflet-map-pane { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; }
```

Resultado: los tiles ahora llenan el viewport completo sin gaps.
